Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/build && python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess, struct, os
# use aomdec if present
for exe in ['aomdec','dump_obu']:
  p='./'+exe
  if not os.path.exists(p):
    continue
  print('EXE',exe)
  hdr = b'DKIF' + struct.pack('<HHIIII', 0, 32, 64, 64, 30, 1) + struct.pack('<I', 1)
  payload = b'\x00'*100
  path='/tmp/t.ivf'
  open(path,'wb').write(hdr + struct.pack('<IQ', len(payload), 0) + payload)
  r=subprocess.run([p,path],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
  print(r.returncode, r.stderr.decode('latin1').splitlines()[:10])
PY
